limitations: Fallback unseen coverage (12 tasks, one per domain) is the frozen outcome-blind admission; the full 24-task panel was projected infeasible in Goal 7 and is explicitly missing by design.
One training seed (17) per cell; no training-seed variance claimed.
Model-arm downstream success is measured under canonical BFS action order with a 2x exact-reference call limit; not a claim about other search algorithms or policies.
Dataset/episode artifacts use the local outputs corpus-release convention; compact paths/hashes/evidence are committed.

Re-audit validation binds schema, attempt identity, outcome, coverage and the embedded original hook receipt; it does not prove timestamp ordering or commit ancestry, and the evidence does not claim otherwise.
